sn46.28:1.8: Evam vutte āyasmā Udāyi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn46.28:1.9: Katham bhāvitā nu kho bhante satta bojjhaṅgā katham bahulīkatā nibbedhāya saṃvattantī ti || || 5.
sn46.28:2.1: Idha Udāyi bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vipulam mahaggatam appamāṇam abyāpajjham ||
sn46.28:2.2: so satibojjhaṅgam bhāvitena cittena anibbiddhapubbam appadālitapubbam lobhakkhandham nibbijjhati padāleti ||
sn46.28:2.4: anibbiddhapubbam appadālitapubbam mohakkhandham nibbijjhati padāleti || la-pe ||
sn46.28:2.5: Upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti vivekavirāga- nirodhanissitām vipulam mahaggatam appamāṇam abyāpajjhaṃ ||
sn46.28:2.6: So upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāvitena anibbiddhapubbam appadālitapubbaṃ lobhakkhandham nibbijjhati padāleti ||
sn46.28:2.9: Evam bhāvitā kho Udāyi satta bojjhaṅgā evam bahulīkatā nibbedhāya saṃvattantī
